video.title: Manamune-Lethality Draven is deceptively strong... (Outdamages BT-IE)
video.description:
Draven's cheapest, and, perhaps, most effective build. Cheaper build that foregoes lifesteal for more damage (and utility... from Umbral Glaive). 

Based on a (seemingly) popular Korean Draven builds, but slightly modified. (The build usually goes Sanguine Blade after Manamune, according to the data websites.) Sanguine Blade is definitely a better item, assuming you can trigger the passive. But that reasonably should not be happening very much, which would make it an inconsistent purchase overall...

Footage from: May 15, 2020

About the dummy tests: don't take them too seriously. It was simply included to give an idea of the damage numbers, and may not be as accurate in an actual gameplay scenario. But Manamune generally should out-damage the BT-IE build.

video.title: How To STOMP Sona & Taric Bot Lane
video.description:
I recommend using poke lanes to beat Sona/Taric bot lanes.  This is counter intuitive since a majority of the time kill beats sustain, sustain beats poke and poke beats kill.  However, Sona/Taric are a unique form of sustain/poke lane that is actually very strong against kill lanes post level 6 but is weak to poke lanes at all stages of the game.  The reason for this is that Taric needs to be in melee range to make use of all of his sustain and Sona needs to be in range of her Q in order to proc her spellthief's to get the gold she needs.  If you have two champions that outrange Sona then she can never get her poke off and any time Taric approaches the minion wave to CS or sustain he will get decimated by two ranged champions.  Once laning phase ends Sona/Taric will struggle because they have weak engage potential which means that the poke champions are free to poke them until the Sona/Taric team try to force an engage.  Then the poking team just needs to disengage, wait out the Taric ult, and then take whatever objectives they want.

No, I don't know why I called it "Tales FROM the Neon Sea" like six times in the audio either, it's just one of those things that happened.

Regardless of the name, Tales OF the Neon Sea is an absolutely gorgeous and incredibly detailed and THOROUGH pixel-art vision of the neo-noir cyberpunk future, populated by excellent character design and environments that pulse with life and vitality.

... unfortunately, the writing does not keep up with the ambition and scope of its visuals, making for a somewhat uneven experience, that I personally found easy to forgive because the visuals are just so dang compelling, but your mileage may vary.

video.title: How To STOMP Sona & Taric Bot Lane
video.description:
I recommend using poke lanes to beat Sona/Taric bot lanes.  This is counter intuitive since a majority of the time kill beats sustain, sustain beats poke and poke beats kill.  However, Sona/Taric are a unique form of sustain/poke lane that is actually very strong against kill lanes post level 6 but is weak to poke lanes at all stages of the game.  The reason for this is that Taric needs to be in melee range to make use of all of his sustain and Sona needs to be in range of her Q in order to proc her spellthief's to get the gold she needs.  If you have two champions that outrange Sona then she can never get her poke off and any time Taric approaches the minion wave to CS or sustain he will get decimated by two ranged champions.  Once laning phase ends Sona/Taric will struggle because they have weak engage potential which means that the poke champions are free to poke them until the Sona/Taric team try to force an engage.  Then the poking team just needs to disengage, wait out the Taric ult, and then take whatever objectives they want.

--------

Read up on the Odyssey universe: https://universe.leagueoflegends.com/en_US/odyssey/

SKINSPOTLIGHTS - GALAXY SLAYER ZED: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Fzi4l3M_FtE

Galaxy Slayer Zed is a great skin, slick, well-animated, lots of cool effects and cool visual ideas... and he doesn't fit into the Odyssey universe as we know it almost at all. His lore is kind of weak, his interactions with other characters are necessarily one-sided, and his one-note personality makes him uninteresting as a monologuing villain.

This all speaks somewhat to the difficulty of following up on such a rock-solid established universe as Odyssey, and the trouble with trying to do story-telling through sheer expansion of the character roster without also deepening the story.

Yeah, it's going to be one of THOSE kinds of videos, kids.
